run_mediapipe_evaluation: run the mediapipe evaluation script to capture hand motion and drive a simulated robot hand in real time
run_main_with_hand_arg: run the main function with a custom hand type like allegro to simulate that robot hand via mediapipe
run_main_with_ckpt_tag: run the main function with a custom checkpoint tag to load a different GeoRT model for motion capture
review_main_loop: review the main loop that polls mediapipe motion capture results and updates the simulated hand joint positions
review_model_forward: review how the loaded GeoRT model forward pass converts mediapipe keypoints into robot joint positions
